WITH client_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        c.district_id,
        d.A3 as region,
        COUNT(c.client_id) as num_clients
    FROM client c
    JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
    GROUP BY c.district_id, d.A3
),
region_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        A3,
        SUM(num_clients) as region_total
    FROM client_counts
    GROUP BY A3
),
grand_total AS (
    SELECT SUM(num_clients) as total FROM client_counts
)
SELECT 
    cc.district_id,
    cc.region,
    cc.num_clients,
    CAST(cc.num_clients AS REAL) / rt.region_total as fraction_of_region,
    CAST(cc.num_clients AS REAL) / gt.total as fraction_of_total
FROM client_counts cc
JOIN region_totals rt ON cc.region = rt.A3
CROSS JOIN grand_total gt
ORDER BY fraction_of_total DESC
LIMIT 10
